config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT uniqExact(service) AS Services FROM hud_otel.process_metrics
WHERE t >= $__toTime - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env)

SELECT uniqExact(instance) AS `Live sessions` FROM hud_otel.process_metrics
WHERE t >= $__toTime - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env)

tiles.name: Services — click one for its overview • Live session: reported in the last 30 min • Running: has a live session

config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT service AS Service, if(live > 0, 'Running', 'Not running') AS Status, toUInt32(live) AS `Live sessions`,
    toUInt32(fns) AS `Functions invoked`, toUInt32(flows) AS `Flows invoked`,
    if(seen > 0, round(dateDiff('second', seen, $__toTime) / 60, 1), NULL) AS `Last seen (min ago)`,
    round(100 * errs / nullIf(runs, 0), 1) AS `Err Rate %`, ${env:sqlstring} AS Env
FROM (SELECT service, uniqExact(instance) AS sess FROM (SELECT t, service, instance FROM hud_otel.process_metrics WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, instance FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, instance FROM hud_otel.process_metrics_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env)) GROUP BY service) AS ss
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, uniqExact(instance) AS live FROM hud_otel.process_metrics
    WHERE t >= $__toTime - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env) GROUP BY service) AS lv USING (service)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, uniqExact(function) AS fns FROM hud_otel.functions
    WHERE last_seen >= $__fromTime AND $__filter(env, $env) GROUP BY service) AS fn USING (service)
LEFT JOIN (SELECT service, uniqExactIf(flow, r > 0) AS flows, sum(r) AS runs, sum(e) AS errs, max(ls) AS seen FROM (
    SELECT service, flow, sum(runs) AS r, sum(errors) + sumIf(issues, flow_type != 'http') AS e, max(last_seen) AS ls
    FROM (SELECT t, service, flow, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, 0 AS issues, last_seen FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT t, service, flow, flow_type, 0 AS runs, 0 AS errors, issues, last_seen FROM hud_otel.endpoint_counters WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues, last_seen FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, flow, flow_type, duration_count AS runs, if(startsWith(status_code, '5'), duration_count, 0) AS errors, issues, last_seen FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env))
    GROUP BY service, flow) GROUP BY service) AS fl USING (service)
WHERE sess > 0
ORDER BY live DESC, seen > 0 DESC, seen DESC, service
LIMIT 500

SELECT toStartOfInterval(t, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AS ts, service AS Service, sum(duration_count) / greatest(1, dateDiff('second', ts, least(ts + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600))), least(toStartOfInterval($__toTime - INTERVAL 1 SECOND, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600))) + toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, 1, 3600)), now())))) AS `Runs/s`
FROM (SELECT t, service, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600 AND t >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND t < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600) AND hour >= toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env))
WHERE service IN (SELECT service FROM (SELECT t, service, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_durations WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND t >= $__fromTime AND t < $__toTime AND (t < toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR OR (toStartOfHour($__toTime) > toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND t >= toStartOfHour($__toTime))) AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE $__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND hour < toStartOfHour($__toTime) AND $__filter(env, $env)
  UNION ALL SELECT hour AS t, service, duration_count FROM hud_otel.endpoint_metrics_lean_1h WHERE NOT ($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND hour >= toStartOfHour($__fromTime) AND hour < $__toTime AND $__filter(env, $env))
                  GROUP BY service ORDER BY sum(duration_count) DESC LIMIT 10)
GROUP BY ts, Service ORDER BY Service, ts WITH FILL FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))) TO $__toTime STEP toIntervalSecond(if($__fromTime >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND {intervalSeconds:Int64} < 3600, greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 300), greatest({intervalSeconds:Int64}, 3600)))
